summary: Iteration 20 retest of the 3 iter19 defects + Ore Lavoro regression. RETEST 1 (clear Uscita) PASS: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter20_fixes.py (6/6) proves PUT /api/time-entries now accepts explicit nulls - {clock_out: null} returns clock_out=null, GET confirms persistence, clock_in/notes can also be nulled, omitted fields untouched, re-setting clock_out works, unknown id -> 404. Confirmed end-to-end in the UI: created 2026-08-20 08:00-18:00 (9h/+1h), cleared Uscita + Salva -> row shows 08:00/—/—/— and stays cleared after full reload. RETEST 2 (mobile overflow 390px) PASS: /ore-lavoro at 390x844 has documentElement.scrollWidth=390, body.scrollWidth=390, 0 of 62 .ore-row elements exceed the viewport, no element in the DOM overflows to the right; stacked layout renders readable prefixed cells (giorno / In / Out / Pausa / Lav / delta / azioni). RETEST 3 (rename onBlur) PASS: typing 5 chars in emp-name-{id} fires 0 PUT /api/employees; exactly 1 PUT on blur; rename persists across reload; daily_hours 8->6 fires 0 PUTs while typing and exactly 1 on blur; blur without a change fires 0 PUT. Regression: iter19 suite 15/15 green; UI verified agenda TimeTrackerWidget (A casa -> Timbra ingresso -> 'Al lavoro da 08:00' -> Timbra uscita -> '08:00-17:00 · 8h', buttons disappear when everyone is done), ore-lavoro month/year selects, banca-ore cards (+1h / 0h, restored to original values after cleanup), row create/edit/delete, print button, employees dialog, Alfonso+Bruno seed. Zero console errors in all runs. Backend 21/21, frontend 100% of retested flows.

minor.issue: Still strips explicit nulls (`if v is not None`) - unlike time-entries it was not changed. Harmless today (no nullable employee field is edited by the UI) but inconsistent with the time-entry handler.
Carried over from iter19 and still open: no uniqueness on employee_id+date (duplicates silently hidden by the UI Map) and no format validation on date/clock_in/clock_out (any string accepted).
daily_hours still accepts 0 / negative values, which makes the delta arithmetic meaningless.

issues: Overflow fixed, but each empty day now occupies 3 stacked lines (In/Out, Pausa/Lav, delta) so a full month is ~62 tall rows -> very long scroll. Consider collapsing days with no entry to a single compact line.
Toast ('Eliminata'/'Salvato') renders top-center and covers the 'BANCA ORE · REPORT MENSILE' eyebrow/title; cosmetic only.

action_items: No blocking action: all 3 iter19 fixes verified. Optional: align PUT /api/employees null handling with time-entries, add employee_id+date uniqueness + date/time format validation on POST /api/time-entries, validate daily_hours > 0, compact empty day rows on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PUT /api/time-entries now writes the raw payload with exclude_unset - fine, but nothing validates ISO format, so a client can persist clock_out < clock_in or a garbage string (delta math then silently degrades).
OreLavoro.jsx is 564 lines with an inline <style> block containing the mobile/print CSS; consider extracting the CSS to a module to keep the component readable.

EmployeesDialog uses defaultValue+onBlur: correct for the PUT-storm fix, but the inputs are no longer re-synced if refresh() returns a different value (e.g. server-side trim), so a trimmed name would still show the untrimmed text until reload.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral Firebase users via signUp REST for the pytest suites (self-cleaning). UI tests reused ore-iter19-178758287702ce@italserrande.test; the temporary 2026-08-20 entry was deleted and Alfonso's 2026-08-24 entry was re-created via the widget, so the account state (bank +1h / 0h) is identical to before the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suites for this feature: test_iter19_ore_lavoro.py (15) + test_iter20_fixes.py (6), both green. Alfonso id in the shared test account: 23fe134b-9378-43df-8b19-37a28158f2e5. Mobile check pattern: compare document.documentElement.scrollWidth and every .ore-row getBoundingClientRect().right against window.innerWidth at 390x844. Remaining open (non-blocking) items are the POST /api/time-entries validation/uniqueness gaps and PUT /api/employees null-stripping.
rca_of_the_issue: Defect 1 root cause was the `if v is not None` filter in the PUT time-entries dict comprehension (nulls dropped before $set); now removed, exclude_unset alone distinguishes 'not sent' from 'explicit null'. Defect 2 was a fixed-column grid inherited on small screens; now a 2-column stacked grid with nth-child repositioning. Defect 3 was a controlled input calling the API in onChange; now defaultValue+onBlur with a valueChanged guard.
